name: cgc-post-listing
description: Quartz 5 component: the site's posts, newest first, filtered to the tag on a tag page, each with its tags ringed in their colours from the cgc-tags engine. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our library and reading-time, and PostCSS checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The library is a `file:` spec on main, which a release commit rewrites to the release's published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-post-listing
